techParks.name: Bengaluru Aerospace Park
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - Aerospace Sector
techParks.description: The aerospace sector of KIADB's Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park beside Kempegowda International Airport, on SH-104 east of the airfield. Brigade and Deccan Herald describe a roughly 1,000-acre industrial park (later quoted at ~2,000 acres with expansion) with about 250 acres notified as an aerospace SEZ. Starrag's 2013 plant was the first factory to start here; it now holds Boeing's 43-acre BIETC campus, Collins Aerospace's 26-acre India Operations Center, the Safran-HAL engine-parts JV, Dynamatic Aerotropolis and a cluster of Indian and foreign aerostructure, avionics and space suppliers. A 1,777-acre expansion across 13 villages was dropped by the state in July 2025 after farmer protests.

techParks.name: KIADB Hardware Park
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - Hardware Sector
techParks.description: KIADB's electronics-hardware sector of the Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park, south-west of the airport between Bellary Road and Mahadeva Kodigehalli. Its anchor is Shell's 52-acre Technology Centre Bangalore; it also holds Cepheid's TB-cartridge plant (2023), Hengst Filtration, Zetwerk Electronics' defence/automotive electronics unit (Feb 2026) and smaller electronics, medical and drone makers.

techParks.name: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - IT Sector
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park (IT Sector)
techParks.description: The IT sector of KIADB's Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park, mapped in OSM as 'Bengaluru IT Park' (KIADB) between the Hardware Park and the aerospace sector. Company addresses here carry the form 'Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park (IT Sector)'. Tenants include SAP Labs India's 41-acre Innovation Park (Aug 2025), the eMudhra Digital Campus and Autoliv India's safety centre and plant; CDC's Technology Innovation International Park and Jayalakshmi Tech Park are under construction alongside.

techParks.name: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park
techParks.locality: Devanahalli taluk (OSM polygon at Polanahalli / Chimachanahalli)
techParks.description: KIADB's umbrella industrial area north-east of Kempegowda airport; companies in its aerospace, hardware and IT sectors all use the name in their addresses (those sectors are listed here as separate parks). The OSM polygon carrying this exact name maps the newer eastern phase at Polanahalli / Chimachanahalli, where Exide Energy Solutions commissioned a 6 GWh lithium-ion cell plant in Sept 2026 and Zeiss has its announced lens plant. Invest Karnataka quotes ~1,000-2,000 acres for the whole park.

techParks.name: Boeing India Engineering and Technology Center
techParks.description: Boeing's 43-acre, Rs 1,600 crore engineering and technology campus inside the Bengaluru Aerospace Park, its largest investment outside the US. PM Modi inaugurated it on 19 Jan 2024 and Building 2 opened in Aug 2024.

techParks.name: Shell Technology Centre Bangalore
techParks.description: A 52-acre custom-built Shell R&D campus for up to 1,500 people inside the KIADB Hardware Park, opened 31 Mar 2017 to consolidate Shell's Bangalore R&D staff; one of Shell's three main global technology hubs.

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Innovation Park
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's 41-acre second Bengaluru campus in the KIADB IT sector near the airport, inaugurated 5 Aug 2025; 27 acres built in phase 1, ~15,000 seats at full build-out, phase 2 targeted for 2028.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Cloud
techParks.description: A 33-acre, seven-tower office campus by Prestige on Bellary Road (NH-44) about 7 km south of Kempegowda airport (towers include Cirrus, Cumulus, Altus, Stratus and Arcus). Walmart Global Tech leased ~1 lakh sq ft in Cumulus from March 2026, and NTT's Bengaluru 4 data-centre campus (up to 100 MW) is on the same site.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Signature Business Park
techParks.description: A 407-acre KSIIDC business district planned next to Kempegowda airport (business, MICE, design-and-culture and innovation districts plus the Bengaluru International Convention Centre). Foundation stone laid Feb 2018 after a decade in abeyance; in May 2026 the cabinet cleared 140 acres for Applied Materials, with 267 acres left to allot.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Airport City Business Park
techParks.description: A 2 million sq ft, four-block business park on 17.7 acres inside the airport campus, targeting global capability centres. Bengaluru Airport City Ltd, a BIAL subsidiary, broke ground in Oct 2024 and projected first occupancy in 2026; no tenants named yet.

techParks.name: Technology Innovation International Park
techParks.description: A planned technology park by CDC Development India, approved at Rs 740 crore with 100 acres allotted in the Devanahalli aerospace / hi-tech park area; OSM maps it as a construction site north of SAP's campus. No tenants found.

coverageNotes: Lens G19 (north Bengaluru towards Kempegowda airport). Every coordinate is inside lat 12.75-13.25 / lng 77.35-77.90; the northernmost office is Zeiss at 13.228. LEFT OUT because it is outside the box: Foxconn's Devanahalli/ITIR iPhone plant (Hon Hai Technology India Mega Development, ~30,000 staff). Nominatim puts 'Foxconn' at 13.3043, 77.6154 (Byadarahalli), and the villages named in press (Doddagollahalli 13.295, Koira 13.303, Aruvanahalli 13.303) are all north of 13.25. Tata Electronics' Narasapura plant and Vemagal OSAT are in Kolar district, also outside, so it carries only its Sarjapur Road office (approximate Photon pin). NOT CONFIRMED, so not included: Aequs (only Belagavi found); Airbus (its 2026 Airbus India Technology Centre is elsewhere in Bengaluru, see E11); Rolls-Royce (Manyata GCC, Bellandur IAMPL JV; nothing in this lens); Lockheed Martin (only as TASL's partner on the C-130J MRO, recorded under TASL); Honeywell (a 30-acre ITTeS allotment at Devanahalli was approved around 2014, but no build was found); Bosch, L&T and Wipro Ltd (no northern site found; Wipro appears only as Wipro Enterprises' WIN aerospace plants); STT GDC and AdaniConneX (no northern data centre found; STT's Bengaluru DCs are in Whitefield); Hical Technologies (headline of a Devanahalli facility launch on 6 Oct 2026, but no park or coordinates); Brigade's WTC Devanahalli (pre-launch, no site point); IFFCO nano-urea plant, Autocrat, Autoplast, OLEO, Advanced Fiber Systems, Poornima Medical, Pramodaya, Altius Aerotech and other small OSM-only units; and the 'Kalyani Tech Park (u/c)' polygon in the aerospace park (Safran's R&D centre 'in Kalyani Tech Park' is in E11 as the K R Puram park, not this one). THE WEB SEARCH BUDGET RAN OUT partway through, so these were confirmed by fetching company pages directly or rest on OSM: Dedienne Aerospace, Juki and Elmeasure are OSM-only (low); Star Air's office node and Agratas' Prestige Tech Cloud node are OSM-only (low). LOCATION CAVEATS: Safran HAL, the Wipro Aerospace sites, tk accelis, Magellan, AXISCADES DAC and Centum's new unit have no mapped plot, so they use the Bengaluru Aerospace Park centroid with confidence medium. Safran Electronics & Defense's 'airport area' plant is also pinned there, at low confidence. Air India's MRO and BIAL use the airport polygon centroid; WFS and Menzies use the OSM Cargo District centroid; NTT's Bengaluru 4 uses the Prestige Tech Cloud centroid. PARK NAMING: KIADB's 'Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park' is an umbrella name used in addresses across three physically separate sectors, so they are recorded as separate parks: Bengaluru Aerospace Park (aerospace/SEZ sector), KIADB Hardware Park, and 'Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - IT Sector' (OSM 'Bengaluru IT Park': SAP, eMudhra, Autoliv). The canon 'Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park' entry uses the OSM polygon of that exact name, the eastern Polanahalli phase with Exide and Zeiss. G14 placed Boeing at that polygon's centroid (13.224, 77.773); Boeing's campus is actually at 13.1819, 77.7219 (OSM way/991727364). CATEGORY JUDGEMENTS: BIAL is recorded as Indian MID_SIZE even though Fairfax India (Toronto) holds a majority. Air India is MID_SIZE because no category fits an unlisted Indian firm with more than 10,000 staff. ITC is MNC under the listed Indian, more-than-10,000-staff rule. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering belongs to unlisted Wipro Enterprises, not Wipro Ltd. Zeiss' Devanahalli plant and Applied Materials' BSBP allotment are marked planned. No headcounts were invented; only figures a source states are given (Rakon ~500, Shell 1,500 capacity).
